problems.claim: Complex Fourier L1 equals amplitude L1 plus phase L1
assumptions: All coefficients nonzero with positive real parts
problems.result: Complex and Cartesian L1=2/3; polar sum=2(sqrt2-1)/3+pi/2

P1.source: Read pp.3,7 and Appendix A.7 p.15; actually viewed p.15 to confirm square-root normalization in (13)-(14).
P1.independent_argument: At (u,v)=(0,0), every exponential is 1, so F00=(sum x)/sqrt(HW)=sqrt(HW) GAP and amplitude=abs(F00)=sqrt(HW)|GAP|. H=W=2, constant +1 gives 1 versus 2; constant -1 gives -1 versus 2. Positive input already refutes scale equality.
P1.alternative_and_dependency: A mean-normalized DFT would remove scale but not modulus for signed features. A weak DC-statistic correspondence is valid. The defect does not force GAP to be replaced or establish deraining damage.
P1.severity_and_repair: Minor retained for this explanatory equivalence; the general scaled signed relation is the exact local repair.

references.anchors: pooled channel feature corresponds to amplitude center

P2.source: Read main Eq.(12) p.7, Appendix A.16 Eq.(15) p.22 and loss ablation Table16/p.23.
P2.independent_argument: Using the 1/2-normalized four-point DFT, x=(1,1/3,1/3,1/3) maps to (1,1/3,1/3,1/3), while y=(1,2/3,1/3,0) maps to (1,(1-i)/3,1/3,(1+i)/3). All pixels are admissible and Fourier real parts positive. Complex differences sum to 2/3. Two amplitude differences sum to 2(sqrt(2)-1)/3 and two phase differences sum to pi/2, giving about 1.84694. No atan quadrant issue or zero phase is used.
P2.alternative_and_dependency: The polar RHS may independently define a legitimate loss, but then the displayed equality is a notational redefinition rather than a norm identity. Table16 values 39.67/39.69/39.75/39.73 PSNR support limiting the claim to specification.
P2.severity_and_repair: Minor retained; correct the loss description and name actual phase wrapping/normalization. Identity |ae^(i phi)-be^(i psi)|^2=(a-b)^2+2ab(1-cos(phi-psi)) follows directly from conjugate multiplication; no retraining consequence is inferred.

C1.source: Read Eq.(2) p.3 literal arctan(I/R), and report qualifications about absent implementation.
C1.independent_argument: For -1+i, I/R=-1 gives principal arctan -pi/4; multiplying exp(i phi) by sqrt(2) returns 1-i instead of -1+i. Quadrant-aware arg corrects it.
C1.alternative_and_dependency: Authors may have used atan2/angle and abbreviated notation. No repository establishes actual use, so historical implementation remains unresolved. Exact scan/Hermitian handling is likewise unverified rather than asserted wrong.
C1.severity_and_repair: Needs Evidence retained for implementation impact; no promoted Major or invented failed experiment.
